title.narrative: Inception phase STS and STA Tax Project 2022-2023
Inception phase STS and STA Tax Project 2022-2023

description.narrative:
Den Skatteverket har ansökt Sida om finansiering på 1 000 000 SEK för att genomföra genomförbarhetsfasprojekt för utveckling av ett nytt samarbetsprogram med den Moldaviska statliga skattetjänst under september 2021 - february 2022.
Insatsen syftar till att 1) identifiera omfattningen av ett nytt potentiellt program med beaktande av de resultat som uppnåtts och lärdomarna från det föregående programmet och 2) konkret definiera "vad" det ska uppnås med det nya programmet och "hur" genom att utveckla ett konkret projektförslag.
Insatsens totala budget är 1 000 000 SEK fullständigt täckt av Sida.

The Swedish Tax Administration has applied to Sida for funding of 1 000 000 SEK to carry out the Feasibility Phase Project for development a new cooperation programme with the Moldovan State Tax Service during September 2021- February 2022.
The intervention aims at 1) identifying the scope of a new potential programme, considering the results achieved and lessons learned from the previous programme and 2) defining in concrete terms "what" is to be achieved by the new programme and "how" by developing a concrete project proposal.
The intervention’s total budget is 1000 000 SEK fully covered by Sida.

This is a short term feasibility phase type intervention. The main objective is to support the Swedish Tax Authority (STA) to develop a project proposal to continue its cooperation with the Moldovan State Tax Service. The feasibility phase will allow STA to identify and assess the needs that could be further addressed and to define the terms and conditions for a new project based on results achieved and lessons learned in the previous project in 2018-2021.
The intervention resulted in a good quality project proposal that then became the programme document for the third phase of collaboration between the Swedish and Moldovan Tax agencies.
